name: Vampire
description: Vampire Format is a DM era format that predates the first banlist. The latest core set is Dark Crisis (DCR). Notable additions include D.D. Warrior Lady, Vampire Lord, Butterfly Dagger - Elma, and Skill Drain. Magical Scientist is now Limited. Warrior Control mostly replaces Tomato Control, and Zombie becomes a viable rogue deck.

defining_cards.name: D.D. Warrior Lady
defining_cards.why: She could banish herself and the monster she battled, removing threats such as Vampire Lord without sending them to the Graveyard.

defining_cards.name: Vampire Lord
defining_cards.why: Pyramid Turtle could summon it from the Deck, and an opponent who destroyed it by card effect faced its return in the next Standby Phase.

defining_cards.name: Breaker the Magical Warrior
defining_cards.why: Its Spell Counter gave it 1900 ATK or could be spent to destroy a Spell or Trap before committing another attacker.

defining_cards.name: Don Zaloog
defining_cards.why: A battle-damage hit could discard a random opposing card, making it dangerous to leave an opening for this Mystic Tomato target.

defining_cards.name: Pyramid Turtle
defining_cards.why: Losing it in battle brought a Zombie straight from the Deck, including high-Level monsters with 2000 or less DEF.
